notes: Original article (Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 46 (2021) 31084-31095), is_retracted false in record.json, no retraction notice in the text. H2 uptake of GRHA 1:1, 1:3 and 1:5 measured in a custom-made static volumetric rig at 30 bar; temperature 25 degC appears in Table 3 (text says 'room temperature'). Reported units are internally inconsistent: '974 mmol/g (1.95 wt %)' for GRHA 1:3, and Fig. 10 axis and Table 4 give mmol/g values of 252-974, which cannot equal 0.50-1.95 wt % (1.95 wt % is about 9.7 mmol/g). Does not affect eligibility; extractors should treat the unit conflict per section 3. 30 bar is the set charging pressure; the equilibrium pressure after expansion into the adsorption cell is not stated. I2 rests on the authors' description of GRHA as a porous carbon / graphene-like material (Raman, XRD); the paper gives no elemental composition, so majority-carbon by mass is not shown directly. I4: BET SSA reported for RHA (8.37), GRHA 1:1 (304.86), GRHA 1:3 (315.07), GRHA 1:5 (270.21) m2/g, same samples as the H2 uptake. si1 is a Turnitin similarity report (14 percent index; 1 percent match to the authors' earlier GRHA/ZIF-8 hydrogen paper) followed by the submitted manuscript text; it holds no additional data. A similarity match is not a statement by the paper that its H2 values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply.
